customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of excellent quality and appreciate its features, including the LED light that gives it a modern look and the ability to adjust TDS levels. Moreover, they like the installation process, which includes free installation, and consider it good value for money, with one customer noting it saves money by not using RO. Additionally, they like the taste, with one mentioning it matches Bisleri's taste, and they find the purifier reliable, though some report it stopped working.

reviews.author: BOLLA PAVAN REDDY
reviews.title: Sleek, Smart, and Super Fast Installation! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.body: I am absolutely loving the Atomberg water purifier.the design is incredibly sleek, smooth, and sexy—it gives a truly classic and rich look to the kitchen.The smart features are a game-changer. Being able to control it entirely through my phone and monitor the live health of the purifier on the mobile app is incredibly convenient. Most importantly, the water taste is excellent. A huge shoutout to their service team as well—within just 3 hours of delivery, the installation team arrived, set everything up perfectly, and took the time to clearly explain every single feature. Highly recommended
